egress.terms: no published per-GB egress charge; free downloads are heavily throttled (that walkthrough measured ~700 KB/s down vs 15-17 MB/s up)

tooling: rclone backend 'linkbox' (Tier 5, since v1.65; since v1.74 needs API token *and* email/password because listing/downloading moved to account auth)
chaining: If the edu/gov verification path still works, one verified identity yields 10 TB. That is 2000x the base tier, i.e. the largest single-account multiplier in this niche; otherwise 5 GB x unlimited accounts.
limits_note: free downloads throttled to under 1 MB/s; the site is a JS SPA (www.linkbox.to now serves a 'TeleBox' bundle) so quotas are not readable without executing JS; rclone backend is Tier 5, i.e. least-tested

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose: Standard registration grants 5 GB free. Upgrades to higher capacity require educational or governmental email verification.
